A white or almost white crystalline powder. Practically insoluble in water; freely soluble in alcohol. Store at a temperature of 2° to 8°. Protect from light. Eur. 6.2 (Sodium Fusidate). A white or almost white, slight- ly hygroscopic, crystalline powder. Freely soluble in water and in alcohol. A 1.25% solution in water has a pH of 7.5 to 9.0. Store in airtight containers at a temperature of 2° to 8°. Protect from light. Incompatibility. UK licensed product information states that reconstituted sodium fusidate injection is incompatible with in- fusion solutions containing glucose 20% or more, lipid infusions, and peritoneal dialysis fluids; precipitation may occur in solu- tions with a pH of less than 7.4. Adverse Effects and Precautions Apart from mild gastrointestinal upsets, fusidic acid or sodium fusidate appear to be well tolerated when given orally.
